fusions.name: Deep Bellow
fusions.desc: A bellow from your swollen throat rolls 5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 26 damage to everything in the cone. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Headlong Spring
fusions.desc: You butt the target head-first for 14 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Army on the Hoof
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Long Wait, Short Strike
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
